finalText:
**Big. 1,291 hits across 94 of 97 files.**

Only service and http layers rename freely. That is 725 hits. Four spots must keep `account_id`:

| where | why |
| --- | --- |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8), [docs/openapi.yaml:16](docs/openapi.yaml:16) | public wire name, frozen |
| `migrations/*.sql`, 61 hits | applied history, breaks the down step |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/`, 20 hits | `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites it |
| repo SQL strings, 125 hits | real DB column, needs its own migration |

Next: sign off on internals only. Send the column rename back for a migration plan.
